title: Notz
tagline: A Minimal and privacy focused personal note taking app powered by Worldcoin.
description:
Notz is a simple Note Taking tool that focuses on Privacy & Anonymity. 

We use (basic) E2E encryption to encrypt the notes, and World coin to sign in to the app. A user can create window, in which he can create editors to create notes.

All data will be stored in a database in real time.
how_its_made:
This project uses web-crypto with end-to-end encryption in the app. We use NextJS for the frontend framework, and tailwindcss for the styling. We also use Shadcn UI Components as a component library. As in case of database, we use Pocketbase.

For the Notes Editor we use Visual Studio Code's Monaco Editor, we plan to use it advance capabilities like syntax highlighting & suggestions to make easy way to create app.
